title: Keats–Shelley Memorial House

buildingCutout.basis: Named OpenStreetMap building polygon at Piazza di Spagna 26.

terrainReference.basis: Original TINITALY bare-earth terrain along the low, Piazza di Spagna end of the mapped building.

mapIdentity.scope: The exact public-domain exterior already published on Qualla, named mapped footprint, official property records and native bare-earth topography.

note: The documented building rises above the uphill party wall and the worn stair hand wall. The exact public-domain photo establishes the two paired elevations, ornate piano-nobile pediments, dark shutters, recessed roof terrace and rooftop room.
